llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The skill does read environment-selected local paths and writes local reports/archives, but the commands, LYGO_AUTHORITY_ROOT use, indexed path scope, and local-only behavior are disclosed in the artifacts.
[SQP-2] expected: Public anchoring is part of the stated mint/archive workflow, but SECURITY.md and AGENT_CONTRACT.md require human review, avoid secrets, and use mint/anchor only with explicit user request.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean with no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this supports but does not determine the benign verdict.
[StaticScan] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, and artifact review found no hidden network calls, destructive operations, or credential handling.
llm.guidance: Before installing, make sure LYGO_AUTHORITY_ROOT points only at the intended LYGO workspace. Review any MASTER_ARCHIVE.md before minting or public anchoring, especially FRAGILE entries, because hashes and paths can still reveal private project structure even when file contents are not copied.
llm.summary: This skill is a local memory-index audit and archive helper whose file access and outputs are disclosed and aligned with its purpose.
